title: Code Reviewer Skill config
description: Vendor-neutral configuration. The skill never ships default external hosts. A reviewed repository declares its own Git layout, conventions, and optional HTTP integrations.

defaultBaseBranch.description: Preferred compare base when the user does not name a branch. If that ref is missing, the playbook tries main then master. Typical values: main, master, develop.

codeBrowseUrlTemplate.description: Optional. Placeholders: {org} {repo} {branch} {path} {line} {sha}. Empty means backtick paths in the report.

layers.description: Directory prefixes used for scope mapping and multi-agent grouping. Empty arrays fall back to common src/* defaults.

backend.description: Server-side path prefixes for scope mapping (Java/Kotlin/resources). Empty falls back to src/main/java, src/main/kotlin, src/main/resources.

conventions.description: Optional handwritten project conventions. Empty values disable the related rule.

stateLibrary.description: mobx | redux | zustand | jotai | none | empty. Empty = infer from the diff, do not require a library.

httpWrapper.description: Module path of the project's HTTP helper, e.g. src/lib/http. Empty = do not flag raw fetch/axios.

backendLanguage.description: java | kotlin | go | python | c | cpp | empty. Empty = infer from the diff, do not require a language.

integrations.description: Named HTTP endpoints. The skill calls only enabled entries that already have a URL. Never invent hosts.

prMetadata.description: Optional GET/POST that returns PR title and body JSON when git log is not enough.

notify.description: Optional webhook after a finished review. Send a summary payload, not full source.

telemetry.description: Optional counts-only callback (mode, file count, P0/P1/P2). No secrets, no source.

extraKnowledge.description: Optional GET of extra Markdown rules maintained by the enterprise.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL. Placeholders: {org} {repo} {branch} {path} {line} {baseBranch} {sha}. Optional ${ENV_NAME} in the URL is resolved at request time only.

auth.description: How to attach credentials. Token values come from environment variables, never from committed JSON.

tokenEnv.description: Env var that holds the token / API key. Default CODE_REVIEWER_TOKEN.

usernameEnv.description: Basic auth username env. Default CODE_REVIEWER_USER.

passwordEnv.description: Basic auth password env. Default CODE_REVIEWER_PASSWORD.

required.description: If true (default when type is not none), skip the call when the env var is missing instead of sending an unauthenticated request.
